query:
UPDATE account_research_chunks
SET
    topic_tags = $4,
    source_type = $5::account_research_chunk_source_type,
    source_reference = COALESCE($6, $3),
    confidence = $7,
    content = $8,
    input_chunk_ids = $9,
    prompt_id = $10,
    prompt_version = $11,
    retrieval_query = $12,
    model_id = $13,
    generated_at = $14,
    version = account_research_chunks.version + 1,
    updated_at = now()
WHERE organization_id = $1
  AND account_id = $2
  AND data_type = 'SIGNAL'::account_research_chunk_data_type
  AND source_url = $3
RETURNING id
